The Works plate, and the surface with it, lists The Blot That Spread (#611) and Signature as Compressed Portraiture (#612) as Wells works; the registry seats both under Ayanna Vox, and the Zenodo record for #611 lists Vox, Fraction, Wells and Sharks.
